chapter_level.guidance: This whole એકમ is a scene from the Mahabharat (ગુરુ દ્રોણાચાર્ય and their કૌરવ-પાંડવ શિષ્યો) — teach it as a story about a guru's teaching method and the value of એકાગ્રતા, the way the chapter itself frames it ('આ સંવાદમાં ધ્યેયનું મહત્ત્વ રજૂ થયું છે'), never as religious instruction or itihas-as-fact. Do not add anything about the characters' divine status, their later roles, or any Mahabharat lore beyond this printed scene (no birth stories, no boons, no mention of the Kurukshetra war) — the text stops at 'તું મહાન બાણાવળી થઈશ' and so must the explanation, in every explanation, real_life_example, and recall_question across all nine topics.

Duryodhan's impatience ('આ અન્યાય છે', wanting his turn first, M1.S2.T3) is printed character texture only — do not build it into an account of કૌરવ-પાંડવ rivalry or foreshadow the war between them; the chapter itself never mentions it, and a std-6 L2 child should meet these as a guru's students taking a test, not as future adversaries. Keep any explanation or recall_question about M1.S2.T3 and M1.S3.T7 focused on the test and the guru's patience, not on who these princes later became.

chapter_level.caution: The chapter's central action is an archery test — ધનુષ્ય-બાણ, ભીમનું ગદા, and repeated 'વીંધવું' (piercing an eye with an arrow) across M1.S2.T3 through M2.S4.T8 — and a real_life_example or an image prompt could slide into showing or encouraging a child to handle a real bow-and-arrow, a mace, or to throw/shoot something at a target.
chapter_level.guidance: Keep every real_life_example anchored in a safe domain of focus — an exam, a cricket catch, a carrom shot, homework done with the TV off — never a literal bow-and-arrow demonstration; where explanation must name the weapons (they are printed and should not be hidden), state plainly that this is Arjun's practiced skill under a guru's supervision, not something to try at home. Also keep the printed detail that the target was 'રૂના બનાવેલા પંખીની આંખ' — a cotton-made bird, not a live one — in any explanation or image prompt for M2.S4.T8, so the scene is never pictured as harming a real bird.
